Container.Name: hound
Container.Overview:
Hound is a self-hosted media server.
SETUP: Hound requires a PostgreSQL database (v18 recommended). 1. Install a Postgres container from Community Applications. 2. Create a database (hound_db) and a user (hound) with a password. 3. Enter the Unraid server IP and Postgres port below as POSTGRES_HOST / POSTGRES_PORT, along with the same database name, user and password. (A container name like hound-postgres works only if you put both containers on the same custom Docker network.) 4. Set HOUND_SECRET to a long random string.

Config.Name: Movies Library (optional)
Config.Description: Optional external movie library. Read the docs before enabling.

Config.Name: TV Shows Library (optional)
Config.Description: Optional external TV library. Read the docs before enabling.

Config.Name: HOUND_SECRET
Config.Description: Required. Long random secret used for auth. Change from any example value.

Config.Name: POSTGRES_HOST
Config.Description: Unraid server IP, or the Postgres container name if both share a custom Docker network.

Config.Name: POSTGRES_PASSWORD
Config.Description: Postgres password (must match the Postgres container)
